avis.texte: Gave me the worst allergic reaction of my life. I love good molecules for my dry and slightly sensitive skin, but this product was a miss for me. After one use, I woke up in hives that were super painful and uncomfortable for almost 2 weeks. I had to ice my face and constantly take allergy pills. Apparently citrus is a common allergen, so be smarter than me and spot test before using it on your whole face. My skin went from clear to covered in hives overnight.
I tried to use the product but ended up returning it. The smell is awful and doesn't smell anything like pineapples.
I love this product! A little goes a long way! It makes my skin feel so soft, smooth, and even adds a glow to my skin! My skin stays soft for days! I definitely will be repurchasing!

avis.titre: I won't buy this product again.
avis.texte: Don't buy this product if you are looking for exfoliator. I was looking for exfoliating product, couldn't find anything in whole store and being tired of that i grabbed this one. And it was mistake. I was expecting exfoliating but i would describe this product as an cleanser. The describing of the product is very confusing. Not really matching with description. Im sad :( For sure it is not a product for every type of skin and needs but on the box it says it's for every type of skin.

After just one use this caused so many pimples to form on my face. It smells like chemicals, nothing like pineapple. I was really hoping this would be a good product since i use other products from this brand, but unfortunately this isnt a good option if you have even the slightest sensitive skin. Definitely do not recommend.
A little goes a long way. My skin feels so clean and refreshed after using!
I was recommended this product by my aesthetician. Super brightning and is a very soft and hydrating exfoliant for my skin.
I was skeptical but bought it today, my skin has never felt smoother and the rest of my products felt like they worked better too. highly recommend!
I hold my breath while using this product as it smells so bad. Its not as gritty as I expected, more like a foaming cleanser than anything
I bought this as an alternative to the dermatological exfoliating powder. It works great and the price is definite great.

Honestly, I use this as my 2nd cleanser, bc I wash my face twice. This works great to get the rest of any residue makeup off and it exfoliates. I actually use it daily even though that's not what's recommended.

Anyone saying this is a good dupe for Dermalogica daily microfoliating powder is either lying or has never used the Dermalogica one. The Good Molecules powder won't mix into a paste no matter how you do it, what type of water is used, or if you use a utensil. I've gone through two bottles of this and it is always, always lumpy, watery, or both at the same time. I don't feel like it exfoliates well at all, which at the end of the day, consistency aside, is what it's meant to do.

I noticed the difference in my skin immediately. It felt smoother and softer, the serums I applied after absorbed more quickly, and my skin looked brighter. This is far better than any other exfoliator I have tried. It did not feel rough upon application either.
As someone with dry/sensitive skin, this works! I've noticed that my skin is way smoother when I use it once a week. The smell isn't great, but I'll take it over artificial fragrances.

Ive used two different dermalogicia exfoliators completely and STILL go back to rebuying this. Its so amazing for smoothening out the skin without stripping moisture. Also gentle to use about 4x a week. It lathers up to a creamy hydrating consistency and my skin just absolutely loves this. Confirmed Holy Grail.
I have really bad texture around my jaw area, and I really started to notice a difference when I use this versus when I don't!

not a perfect dupe for dermalogica microfoliant, but still works well and for the price its close enough. skin is smoother and brighter after just one use and doesnt irritate my sensitive skin. dont be put off by reviews about smell -- anyone mentioning it is too sensitive lol. it is undetectable unless you, like, put it under your nose and inhale deeply. even then its really mild and inoffensive. It works, its gentle, clean, safe for sensitive skin, affordable, and will last you a long time. Reccomend!

I've noticed that in some of the negative reviews people talk about how the texture changes and they don't feel like the exfoliator lasts - so just to be clear for anyone who hasn't used a product like this, it's a chemical exfoliator NOT a manual exfoliator (like a scrub). The powder should dissolve in the small amount of water you add and then create a foam as you rub your hands together that you then apply to your face. I'm 50 with sensitive, dry skin and I have rosacea so finding something that is effective but that doesn't irritate my skin has been really hard to find. This stuff is miraculous! I use it 2 or 3 times a week, and apply it for about 5 minutes before rinsing off. It helps keep my complexion bright and my skin smooth. It does not smell great - think Gerber baby rice cereal scented, not pineapple (sadly) - but it's so effective and so affordable! Highly, highly recommend.

This exfoliating product has been a game-changer for my skin! A little goes a long way. I've been using it for three months now, and I've noticed a significant improvement. Dark spots and uneven skin tone have become much less noticeable, and even my foundation color has changed. This product, combined with a great moisturizer, is all you need.

This is almost a dupe for the dermalogica exfoliating powder. Its not as gritty, so it doesn't have as much of a physical exfoliation. Considering the price/amount difference though, it works good enough for me! The powder is pretty fine, so you want to start using it with as little water as possible so it doesn't dissolve too quick! The lather it gets is nice though.
this exfoliating powder is the one product I will always invest in. the after glow is immediately noticeable, and skin feels so refreshed!
This is an amazing quality product. A little goes a long way. It exfoliates so gently.

Purchased this scrub for the first time as a cheaper alternative for Dermalogica daily microfoliant. This has the same feel and smell but the exfoliating beads are non existent once water gets mixed, but its a good cleaner overall. Great size for the price you pay.

This is my second time to purchase this. I technically haven't even run out of the first bottle, but I didn't want to be without, when I did. I "mix" this with my cleanser. It gives me a good exfoliation without drying.

avis.titre: Found a replacement for my expensive scrub!
avis.texte: This stuff works great! I use it 4 times a week. The downside is it smells like throw up..
I use this every other day or 2 and it leaves my skin looking and feeling refreshed. It definitely does clean my pores. As long as it's doing its job I don't care about the smell.

First of all I was surprised at the size of the bottle for what I paid. I didn't pay a lot of attention when I ordered because it was so affordable. the quality is fantastic. I also love that after you massage it in it turns into an awesome foam. I am hooked!

Ive been using this a little over a year now I love it. I haven't broke out it, my face is the best its ever been :)
This product smells HORRIBLE. It did not exfoliate at all. Threw it away after 2nd use.
I love this stuff, currently on my second bottle, i have sensitive skin and uses this and my skin does amazing.

I love majority of Good Molecules products. But this is my new favorite! I didnt want to break the bank on an exfoliant. This one is amazing! It left my face feeling so smooth and clean. Also helped with getting smooth skin.

I got this after trying a couple other Good Molecules products and I was disappointed. The smell was so bad that after using it twice it went in the trash. To me it smelled like a combination of baby food and a dirty diaper. I'm a mom of 2 and the smell got to me. I could feel it working as an exfoliant but I could not get past the smell.

I bought this because I read it was a dupe for the dermologica exfoliator powder. Its NOT. The only similaritaly is they are powders. This product has no grit for physical exfoliation and it smells awful. Did nothing for my skin.
This is my second time purchasing this product Totally love it. It leaves your skin feeling totally clean, fresh.amd renewed. This is a wonderful skincare product.
I love this product i also love that it doesn't smell fake or fruity the fact that it's all natural makes it even that much more amazing. It's gentle and powerful at the same time.

I like it. My skin is dry and sensitive and I didnt have any issues with the product. The smell is pretty mild. I notice that it has helped with the random rashes I would get all over my face. It also lasts a while. I was worried that it would clump up inside once exposed to moisture but that was not the case. I just had it in the shower for accessibility. Would recommend. 10/10. I naturally have dark circles so I cannot say anything specific change. I am melanated too.

avis.titre: Removed a bunch of dry/flaky skin in one use
avis.texte: Let me start by saying i have dry skin which gets even worse in fall/winter months. During these months i have days where my face is so dry that it becomes flaky no matter how much moisturizer, face oil or other hydrating products i use. I decided to give this a shot and all the flakiness is gone after one single use. I will definitely be adding this into my skincare regimen. Also, i see a lot of comments about the smell, but mine does not smell bad at all. Smells like nothing.

avis.titre: Good but not the dupe you think
avis.texte: Soooo i got this product to save some cash on a very popular product that does something very similar. Although, it works well if youre getting this as a dupe dont get to excited. It does the trick but not as much as the other popular brand.

avis.titre: Took a little while to ge

avis.titre: Amazing works exactly like it says!
avis.texte: I love this product, i have no complaits whatsoever, it exfoliates and brightens my skin perfectly and you get a decent amount for your money. I haven't encourered any weird smell, i love it :)

If you use it religiously it will fade the dark spots it's gentle I had no redness no burning just put a little in your hand mixer with water and it works well I can use it everyday and it's fading my brown spots. I didn't notice any smell.
I do not recommend. Gave a bad skin reaction. Face turned hot and red because of it.
Smells horrible, not much of an exfoliation, and it clumped into an unusable mess. Heed the reviws and skip this product.
I love this exfoliant, its gentle enough for everyday use, i notice an immediate difference in my skin and my product absorption after using this. it's affordable, and the product lasts for months!
This works well but it smells kind of like throw up. I hold my breath while using it.
I didnt even apply it to my face. I could not get past the smell.

avis.titre: Highly recommend. Just don't try to put it on pizza.
avis.texte: So apparently I've been walking around like a lizard in molting season, because the Pineapple Exfoliating Powder from Good Molecules just showed me how much excess face I was carrying. You sprinkle a little of this magical fruit dust, add water, and boom—it turns into a tropical spa potion that politely tells your dead skin cells it's time to pack their bags. It doesn't burn, it doesn't sting—it just foams up like it's saying, "Aloha, gorgeous, let's clear some space for that glow." And suddenly my skin looks like it just returned from vacation (minus the sunburn and mosquito bites).😍

I have combination skin that tends to be very sensitive to products I introduce to my routine, especially any type of exfoliators. This has become a staple in my routine, with zero irritation/reactions. It's significantly helped textured and drier areas of my face without leaving my skin feeling dehydrated. I incorporate it around twice a week and follow up with the rest of my routine.
I love the way this cleanser feels on my skin. It exfoliates my face very well. My face feels smooth and soft after using. I will continue to buy this product. I love it..👏 👏 💯
I use this when I feel like my skin needs a refresh. Leaves my skin feeling soft and ready for the hydration products I use after.
This is what my night routine way missing. I no longer has visible pores. Caution use every other day/night.

avis.titre: This is my favorite exfoliating wash!
avis.texte: I've been buying this over and over again. Really great exfoliating wash that is no to harsh. I have super sensitive skin and I get zero irritation!! Would recommend :)

It smells like throw up and doesn't feel very exfoliating at all. The smell was so bad and I can still smell it on my face and hands after completing my entire skin routine. I'll stick with the Kate Somerville exfoliator.

I really like this product. It does what its supposed to do and makes my skin feel very soft and smooth. The only thing is it smells horrible but it doesn't linger when you wash it off, which is a plus.
For me this product felt more of a cleanser rather than an exfoliant. The powder you mix with drops of water and mix, however there's no granules that felt like I was getting dead skin off my face.

I have super sensitive and eczema prone skin so exfoliating can be tricky. I can use this product twice a week and it doesnt irritate at all. It definitely brightens up my skin and makes it feel very soft and smooth. It lasts forever too. I will repurchase.

I got this because it seemed like it would be much gentler than some other products I've tried. It doesn't take much to do your whole face, maybe about a teaspoon. Also, if you live at high elevations, be careful opening it. I pulled the tab and it made a huge mess on my bathroom counter and floor. I got a face full of powder and accidentally inhaled some, too.

I gave four stars because when I opened it the powder exploded in my face and fell all over my counter and bathroom floor. It got it in my eyes and I inhaled some of it. It was all over my face and clothes. The product is nice. It's a gentle exfoliating wash.

That being said, I do wish it had a little more grit to it. Definitely more of a paste than a scrub-like consistency. I do love the way it leaves my skin feeling, I just wish I could really give my face a good scrub without it dissolving as quickly.

it's a great powder I'm sure. I just want to warn everyone that if you live in a very high altitude, it does explode. 😭 I took off the seal and it made a little pop noise, I thought it was only going to happen twice but it happened again, so like for your information

this has been working for my acne and overall makes my face look great

I was looking for a product to exfoliate my sensitive, picky skin. I have used rice powders in the past with success. I was very hesitant to use an exfoliating acid that you leave on. So I went back to the powder. This does exactly what it says it does. It exfoliates gently and is not harsh at least for me. My skin was super smooth afterwards, and my makeup went on really smoothly the next day. I would probably only use it 2 to 3 times a week in the summer and maybe less in the winter. Just cause I'm really sensitive. I experienced very little redness and no stinging after use. I really recommend this for gentle exfoliation, especially if you can't tolerate leave on exfoliating acids. Also, no fragrance is a bonus!

This stuff makes my skin feel like silk without over exfoliating. I can use just a little for light exfoliation or I can use more if I need more exfoliation. I don't love the smell but it isn't a lingering smell so it's fine.

Yall. This stuff is magical! Total dupe for a more expensive brand. I really love how I can customize the amount of "grit" I want. I've repurchased multiple times, and use it as my PM cleanser 3 times a week.

avis.titre: loveee this for my acne prone sensitive skin
avis.texte: always had acne prone/combo skin and it def got worse being pregnant trying to find a new exfoliation solution but this has worked wonders for me!! if u use it i suggest skipping cleanser so u dont dry ur skin out. i made that mistake at first.
I really like this product. My skin feels so soft & smooth after using andf the price is very reasonable!
Helps with acne, after 3 uses my acne is starting to clear up. The only thing i dont care for is the smell.

It feels so wonderful on my face! Am so glad I purchased this product, i cant wait to use it in the mornings.

I love this powder. It makes my skin feel great, id recommend it for everyone honestly. My full rating is 4.5/5 because the smell of it is pretty pungent, but im glad there is no fragrance added anyway

This exfoliator really makes your skin feel as soft as velvet! I love the powder style - a little goes a long way! 1 point off because I don't love the scent...it's kind of milky? 4/5 love the after-effects :)
This product is incredible. It competes with brands like Dermalogica that offer powder exfoliants, which cost three times more and this formula is more subtle.
Amazing gentle exfoliant. Really clean and effective. Great price.

This product has saved my skin! My skin is hyper sensitive to EVERYTHING!!! I had a skin allergy test done and the doctor's response was "Whoa you are allergic to a lot"! I have tried so many products to try to exfoliate over the years and even those marked for sensitive skin were too rough. When my 42 year old akin decided that it would be getting lines AND pimples (NOT AWESOME!) I started looking for an exfoliant again. This is it forever!!! It is gentle on my skin, affordable, makes my skin so soft and cleared out some little clogged pores that I thought were with me for life! Seriously if you have sensitive skin try this!!!
Easy enough. But would prefer a product that I didn't have to mix in order to use. Premixed is always best.
I love this product! I have sensitive skin and it's not too harsh to use multiple times a week. I'm using it 2 to 3 times a week and it's been really helpful to incorporate into my skin care routine.
The exfoliate works well, leaves skin feeling clean and smooth. I think my skin is too sensitive for it. Each time I use it I have a breakout.

I just love this product. I use it a couple of times per week and it leaves my face baby soft and smooth. I'm a professional esthetician and have now incorporated this product into my facials. I love these products

I cannot recommend this product enough, it's high quality and allows my makeup to go on much smoother. Will definitely repurchase and recommend to everyone!

Highly recommend and it lasts awhile. I wiuldnt recommend daily use but every other day or so I like to use it. Makes ny skin feel refreshed and soft. No harsh chemicals and its rated really well on yuka — so im not worried about harsh ingredients.
My face feels clean but not stripped. I'm able to use less product with the same results. I personally use a silicone face brush to help with application and cleansing.

The best exfoliating face wash. Gentle on the skin and really makes it feel clean afterwards.
